name: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
